verdict.rationale: Airweave's docs show a public GitHub repo with self-host instructions (git clone + ./start.sh) and a community commenter refers to it as part of the 'open source AI space', indicating the source is publicly available. However, no explicit open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) is named anywhere in the evidence pack, so the openness claim can't be fully verified. Missing for 10: explicit license file/name citation, first-party statement confirming license terms.
